title: TBAI
description:
Our project addresses several key challenges faced by traditional social networks. It provides users with the ability to truly own and control their data through decentralized identity management. By using blockchain technology, the platform ensures transparency, immutability, and security for user-generated content in the form of NFTs. This not only empowers users but also mitigates issues related to centralized control and data privacy concerns.

The fine-tuning feature powered by AI allows users to create content that truly reflects their individuality. The inclusion of XMTP enables secure and private communication, overcoming privacy concerns prevalent in centralized platforms. The analytics dashboard powered by The Graph offers users a comprehensive view of their activities, fostering a data-driven approach to personal expression and social interaction.

how_its_made: During the development process, we encountered challenges in integrating various technologies seamlessly. Ensuring a smooth connection between AI generation, NFT creation, and blockchain transactions required meticulous coding and testing. Additionally, implementing private and secure chat functionality with XMTP posed challenges in terms of encryption and user experience. Also for working with Substreams, we need to work with the verified and published contracts which was difficult as we have multiple set of contracts.
